literal: He sent men to complain to the emperor, saying the detailed-stable office wished to kill him, so he dared not stay.
idiomatic: He sent men to complain to the emperor, saying the detailed-stable office wished to kill him, so he dared not stay.

literal: From then on when summoned he never came again.
idiomatic: From then on when summoned he never came again.

literal: Summer, intercalary fourth month, Li Hong gathered a crowd by heterodox ways and made disorder; he was dismembered and the parts displayed at the Five Capitals.
idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth summer month Li Hong gathered a crowd by heterodox ways and made disorder; he was dismembered and the parts displayed at the Five Capitals.

literal: Sixth month, on yimao day Wolanggai State dispatched envoys presenting fine dogs.
idiomatic: On yimao day of the sixth month Wolanggai State sent envoys presenting fine dogs.

literal: On bingchen day Xia State dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On bingchen day Xia State sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, went to Autumn Mountain.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the court went to Autumn Mountain.

literal: Ninth month, halted at Ousi Marsh.
idiomatic: In the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

literal: Eleventh month, on jiawu day Three Departments commissioner Yu Rong administered Southern Court privy commissioner affairs; Southwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Yegu was made Southern Court chancellor.
idiomatic: On jiawu day of the eleventh month Three Departments commissioner Yu Rong administered Southern Court privy commissioner affairs; Southwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Yegu was made Southern Court chancellor.

literal: Twelfth month, on gengxu day Goryeo dispatched envoys to give thanks for the sacrificial mission.
idiomatic: On gengxu day of the twelfth month Goryeo sent envoys to give thanks for the sacrificial mission.

literal: On guichou day Uighurs dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On guichou day Uighurs sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On jiayin day privy council academician Ma Renwang was third associate administrator of affairs.
idiomatic: On jiayin day privy council academician Ma Renwang was made third associate administrator of affairs.

literal: On bingchen day Administrator of Privy Council Affairs Yelü Yan died.
idiomatic: On bingchen day Administrator of Privy Council Affairs Yelü Yan died.

literal: On guihai day Goryeo dispatched envoys to give thanks for mourning leave.
idiomatic: On guihai day Goryeo sent envoys to give thanks for mourning leave.

literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, went to Chun Prefecture.
idiomatic: In the fourth year, in the first spring month the court went to Chun Prefecture.

literal: Initially when Jurchen raised troops, Ashu of the Hesilie division did not follow; his division was sent Sagai to attack him.
idiomatic: Initially when Jurchen raised troops, Ashu of the Hesilie division did not follow; his division was sent Sagai to attack him.

literal: Ashu's younger brother Dibao came to report; an edict admonished that he not be attacked; they did not listen; Ashu came to flee.
idiomatic: Ashu's younger brother Dibao came to report; an edict admonished that he not be attacked; they did not listen; Ashu came to flee.

literal: By then Jurchen dispatched envoys to demand him back; he was not handed over.
idiomatic: By then Jurchen sent envoys to demand him back; he was not handed over.

literal: Summer, fifth month, took summer ease at Sanshui Plain.
idiomatic: In the fifth summer month the court took summer ease at Sanshui Plain.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, Jurchen again dispatched envoys to take Ashu; he was not handed over; Attendant-in-Waiting Axi Bao was then dispatched to ask the reason for many castles built on the border.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month Jurchen again sent envoys to take Ashu; he was not handed over; Attendant-in-Waiting Axi Bao was then sent to ask the reason for many castles built on the border.

literal: Jurchen answered in insolent words: "If Ashu is returned, tribute as before;
idiomatic: Jurchen answered in insolent words, "If Ashu is returned, tribute as before;

literal: otherwise the building of castles cannot cease."
idiomatic: otherwise the building of castles cannot cease."

literal: Thereupon armies north of the Hun River were mobilized and the Northeast Route supreme command office was strengthened.
idiomatic: Thereupon armies north of the Hun River were mobilized and the Northeast Route supreme command office was strengthened.

literal: Aguda then plotted with his younger brothers Nianhan, Hushe, and others — [10]: making Yinjishuge, Yilie, Loushi, Mu, and others commanders, he gathered Jurchen divisions and captured Liao border hawk officials.
idiomatic: Aguda then plotted with his younger brothers Nianhan, Hushe, and others — [10]: making Yinjishuge, Yilie, Loushi, Mu, and others commanders, he gathered Jurchen divisions and captured Liao border hawk officials.

literal: When they attacked Ningzhou, the Northeast Route supreme command office reported it.
idiomatic: When they attacked Ningzhou, the Northeast Route supreme command office reported it.

literal: At the time the emperor was shooting deer at Qing Prefecture; on hearing it he was little concerned and dispatched Haizhou prefect Gao Xianshou to command Bohai troops in relief.
idiomatic: At the time the emperor was shooting deer at Qing Prefecture; on hearing it he was little concerned and dispatched Haizhou prefect Gao Xianshou to command Bohai troops in relief.

literal: Xiao Tabuye encountered Jurchen and fought east of Ningzhou; he was defeated.
idiomatic: Xiao Tabuye encountered Jurchen and fought east of Ningzhou; he was defeated.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on renyin new moon — [11]: Defender of the State Xiao Sixian was made northeast route commander-in-chief; Jingjiang Army military commissioner Xiao Tabuye was deputy; three thousand Khitan and Xi troops, Central Capital forbidden troops and local strongmen two thousand, and more than two thousand martial men selected from all routes — with scout-commander Cui Gongyi as chief escort officer and Crane-Control commander Xing Ying as deputy — led the army to encamp at Chuhe Store.
idiomatic: On the renyin new moon of the tenth winter month — [11]: Defender of the State Xiao Sixian was made northeast route commander-in-chief; Jingjiang Army military commissioner Xiao Tabuye was deputy; three thousand Khitan and Xi troops, Central Capital forbidden troops and local strongmen two thousand, and more than two thousand martial men selected from all routes — with scout-commander Cui Gongyi as chief escort officer and Crane-Control commander Xing Ying as deputy — led the army to encamp at Chuhe Store.

literal: The two armies faced each other; Jurchen troops secretly crossed Huntong River and struck the Liao force by surprise.
idiomatic: The two armies faced each other; Jurchen troops secretly crossed Huntong River and struck the Liao force by surprise.

literal: Xiao Sixian's army collapsed; Cui Gongyi, Xing Ying, Yelü Foliu, Xiao Geshi, and others died; of those who escaped barely seventeen men.
idiomatic: Xiao Sixian's army collapsed; Cui Gongyi, Xing Ying, Yelü Foliu, Xiao Geshi, and others died; of those who escaped barely seventeen men.

literal: Xiao Fengxian feared his younger brother Sixian would be punished and memorialized that the eastern expedition's routed troops everywhere plundered; unless a sweeping pardon were granted they might gather into trouble.
idiomatic: Xiao Fengxian feared his younger brother Sixian would be punished and memorialized that the eastern expedition's routed troops everywhere plundered; unless a sweeping pardon were granted they might gather into trouble.

literal: The emperor followed this; Sixian was only dismissed from office.
idiomatic: The emperor followed this; Sixian was only dismissed from office.

literal: The armies said to one another: "In battle there is death without merit; in retreat there is life without guilt."
idiomatic: The armies said to one another, "In battle there is death without merit; in retreat there is life without guilt."

literal: Therefore the soldiers had no fighting will and fled at sight of the wind.
idiomatic: Therefore the soldiers had no fighting will and fled at sight of the wind.

literal: Eleventh month, on renchen day Commander-in-Chief Xiao Dili and others encamped east of Qinlin Marsh and were again struck by Jurchen; very many soldiers died.
idiomatic: On renchen day of the eleventh month Commander-in-Chief Xiao Dili and others encamped east of Qinlin Marsh and were again struck by Jurchen; very many soldiers died.

literal: On jiawu day Xiao Dili also was dismissed from office for the offense.
idiomatic: On jiawu day Xiao Dili also was dismissed from office for the offense.

literal: — [12]: On xinchou day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Woliduo was made field army commander-in-chief; — [13]: deputy inspector Xiao Yixue and associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Zhangnu were deputies.
idiomatic: — [12]: On xinchou day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Woliduo was made field army commander-in-chief; — [13]: deputy inspector Xiao Yixue and associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Zhangnu were deputies.

literal: Twelfth month, Xian, Bin, Xiang, and the three prefectures and Iron Li and Wunai all rebelled and entered Jurchen.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month Xian, Bin, Xiang, and the three prefectures and Iron Li and Wunai all rebelled and entered Jurchen.

literal: Yixue went to relieve Bin Prefecture; southern army generals Shilou, Telie, and others went to relieve Xian Prefecture; all were defeated by Jurchen.
idiomatic: Yixue went to relieve Bin Prefecture; southern army generals Shilou, Telie, and others went to relieve Xian Prefecture; all were defeated by Jurchen.

literal: Collation Notes
idiomatic: Collation Notes

literal: 1: On xinhai day buried the Benevolent Sage Great Filial Literary Emperor and Empress Xuanyi at Qing Mausoleum — Liao texts collected in eight fascicles, Daozong's mourning proclamation and Xuanyi's mourning proclamation both read renyin and moving the seat to Yongfu Mausoleum.
idiomatic: 1: On xinhai day buried the Benevolent Sage Great Filial Literary Emperor and Empress Xuanyi at Qing Mausoleum — Liao texts collected in eight fascicles, Daozong's mourning proclamation and Xuanyi's mourning proclamation both read renyin and moving the seat to Yongfu Mausoleum.

literal: 2: His younger brother Aguda succeeded — According to the Basic Annals of the Jin History, Yangge
idiomatic: 2: His younger brother Aguda succeeded — According to the Basic Annals of the Jin History, Yangge

literal: (Yingge)〉
idiomatic: (Yingge)〉

literal: died in the third year of Qiantong, guiwei; Wugusun succeeded;
idiomatic: died in the third year of Qiantong, guiwei; Wugusun succeeded;

literal: Wugusun died in the third year of Tianqing, guisi; Aguda succeeded.
idiomatic: Wugusun died in the third year of Tianqing, guisi; Aguda succeeded.

literal: This is mixed narrative; the years do not agree.
idiomatic: This is mixed narrative; the years do not agree.

literal: 3: Song dispatched Lin Zhu to discuss peace with Xia — Lin Zhu: National Records 10, Song History 20, and the Long Compilation all read Lin Shu.
idiomatic: 3: Song dispatched Lin Zhu to discuss peace with Xia — Lin Zhu: National Records 10, Song History 20, and the Long Compilation all read Lin Shu.

literal: 4: Acting Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Delidi — the character shi was originally missing; supplied from the sixth month of the fourth year above and juan 100 of this work, his biography.
idiomatic: 4: Acting Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Delidi — the character shi was originally missing; supplied from the sixth month of the fourth year above and juan 100 of this work, his biography.

literal: 5: Dispatched Liu Zhengfu and Cao Mu to announce — Liu Zhengfu: National Records 10, Song History 20, and the Long Compilation all read Liu Zhengfu.
idiomatic: 5: Dispatched Liu Zhengfu and Cao Mu to announce — Liu Zhengfu: National Records 10, Song History 20, and the Long Compilation all read Liu Zhengfu.

literal: 6: Heluwo was titled Imperial Grand Uncle of Yihe, Benevolent and Sagely — According to the table of imperial sons, sage reads longevity.
idiomatic: 6: Heluwo was titled Imperial Grand Uncle of Yihe, Benevolent and Sagely — According to the table of imperial sons, sage reads longevity.

literal: Heluwo and Tianzuo were separated by a grandfather's generation; "Imperial Grand Uncle" is a title of enfeoffment.
idiomatic: Heluwo and Tianzuo were separated by a grandfather's generation; "Imperial Grand Uncle" is a title of enfeoffment.

literal: 7: Enfeoffed the Goryeo king as Duke of Three Han States and posthumously enfeoffed his father as King of Goryeo — According to Goryeo History 11, in the third year of Shouchang he had already been enfeoffed King of Goryeo; in the sixth year he had already been enfeoffed Duke of Three Han States.
idiomatic: 7: Enfeoffed the Goryeo king as Duke of Three Han States and posthumously enfeoffed his father as King of Goryeo — According to Goryeo History 11, in the third year of Shouchang he had already been enfeoffed King of Goryeo; in the sixth year he had already been enfeoffed Duke of Three Han States.

literal: Also juan 12: sixth year, second month, Liao dispatched envoys to invest him as King of Goryeo; there is no matter of posthumous enfeoffment.
idiomatic: Also juan 12: sixth year, second month, Liao dispatched envoys to invest him as King of Goryeo; there is no matter of posthumous enfeoffment.

literal: 8: First month went to Duck River to second month went to Huntong River to angle for fish — According to the annals, Taiping fourth year second month, "edict changed Duck River's name to Huntong River."
idiomatic: 8: First month went to Duck River to second month went to Huntong River to angle for fish — According to the annals, Taiping fourth year second month, "edict changed Duck River's name to Huntong River."

literal: But afterward the name Duck River was still used and not abolished.
idiomatic: But afterward the name Duck River was still used and not abolished.

literal: 9: His younger brothers Wukimai, Nianhan, Hushe, and others once followed the hunt — According to National Records 10: "Aguda had a younger brother called Wukimai, Nianhan, Hushe, and the like; when Tianzuo each year entered Autumn Mountain, several men always followed on the journey."
idiomatic: 9: His younger brothers Wukimai, Nianhan, Hushe, and others once followed the hunt — According to National Records 10: "Aguda had a younger brother called Wukimai, Nianhan, Hushe, and the like; when Tianzuo each year entered Autumn Mountain, several men always followed on the journey."

literal: Wukimai is Wukimai; Han name Sheng; he was Aguda's younger brother.
idiomatic: Wukimai is Wukimai; Han name Sheng; he was Aguda's younger brother.

literal: Nianhan, original name Nianmeihua, also written Niange; Jin History 74 has a biography as Zonghan;
idiomatic: Nianhan, original name Nianmeihua, also written Niange; Jin History 74 has a biography as Zonghan;

literal: Hushe is Hushe; Great Jin State Records 27 has a biography as Guse.
idiomatic: Hushe is Hushe; Great Jin State Records 27 has a biography as Guse.

literal: Both were Aguda's younger brothers.
idiomatic: Both were Aguda's younger brothers.

literal: 10: Aguda then plotted with his younger brothers Nianhan, Hushe, and others — "younger brother" should be written.
idiomatic: 10: Aguda then plotted with his younger brothers Nianhan, Hushe, and others — "younger brother" should be written.

literal: 3※ Collation Notes"
idiomatic: 3※ Collation Notes"

literal: 9: [text incomplete].
idiomatic: 9: [text incomplete].

literal: 11: Winter, tenth month, renyin new moon — the character winter, supplied according to textual pattern.
idiomatic: 11: Winter, tenth month, renyin new moon — the character winter, supplied according to textual pattern.

literal: The character new moon, supplied according to new-moon investigation.
idiomatic: The character new moon, supplied according to new-moon investigation.

literal: 12: Xiao Dili also was dismissed from office for the offense — According to the text above Xiao Dili is Xiao Sixian; Jin History reads Xiao Shenli.
idiomatic: 12: Xiao Dili also was dismissed from office for the offense — According to the text above Xiao Dili is Xiao Sixian; Jin History reads Xiao Shenli.

literal: 13: Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Woliduo made field army commander-in-chief — National Records 10 reads "Northern associate privy commissioner Yelü Woliduo Liuliu River route commander-in-chief."
idiomatic: 13: Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Woliduo made field army commander-in-chief — National Records 10 reads "Northern associate privy commissioner Yelü Woliduo Liuliu River route commander-in-chief."
